purpose: Freeze the identity-bearing denominator/risk-set, target topology, measure and source-scope grammar required by D08/D12/D13 without selecting storage or implementation.

types.WHOLE_QUESTION_RISK_SET: all respondents lawfully eligible for the exact target question/component under the selected source scope
types.COMMON_ELIGIBLE_RISK_SET: intersection of exact eligibility/observability requirements for every response component required by the query
types.ROUTED_APPLICABLE_RISK_SET: respondents for whom exact routing/applicability authority makes the target meaningful
types.ANCHOR_SELECTED_RISK_SET: respondents satisfying an exact anchor event where the governing query law explicitly selects that denominator family
types.CANDIDATE_QUESTION_RISK_SET: respondents eligible/observable for an exact candidate target where the governing query law explicitly selects that denominator family
types.BRANCH_COHORT_RISK_SET: respondents in an exact replayable branch/cohort, intersected with target eligibility as governed
types.CUSTOM_GOVERNED_RISK_SET: only with an exact separately named risk-set rule/authority; no ad-hoc predicate substitution

derived_denominator_labels.CONDITION_SELECTED_DENOMINATOR: the selected risk-set member set further intersected with C(r); it does not erase the underlying risk-set identity
derived_denominator_labels.WEIGHTED_DENOMINATOR: measure mass over the exact denominator member set; weighting does not change respondent membership by itself

risk_set.member_set_identity_law: Equal denominator counts with different exact respondent member sets, routing rules, applicability rules, condition predicates or source scopes do not establish the same empirical fact.

zero_member_states.ZERO_OVERLAP: a common-eligibility/joint-risk-set construction resolves exactly but contains zero respondents
zero_member_states.ZERO_SUPPORT: the exact R(r) AND C(r) denominator member set resolves exactly and contains zero respondents
zero_member_states.NOT_APPLICABLE: governed applicability law says the query target/risk-set does not apply
zero_member_states.UNRESOLVED: member set cannot be lawfully resolved; never coerce to zero

condition.role: C(r) selects exact respondents inside the independently defined risk set

target.multivariate: exact topology-aware tuple/configuration of 2..k governed response target components

joint_order_semantics.SEMANTIC_ORDERED: component order is interpretation-critical and preserved
joint_order_semantics.CANONICAL_SET_ORDER: governing target says component order is nonsemantic; components are canonicalized by exact semantic identity

response_topology.SCALAR_SINGULAR: one canonical event only when exact topology authority proves singularity
response_topology.UNORDERED_MULTISELECT: target cell retains exact selected-set identity
response_topology.ORDERED_SEQUENCE: target cell retains exact semantic event order
response_topology.REPEATED_EVENT: target cell retains event identity/repetition index as governed
response_topology.ROUTED_RESPONSE: target interpretation is bound to exact routing/applicability semantics

target.special_state_law: DK/refusal/IAP/not-asked/inapplicable/missing/source-specific special states remain typed and may enter target content only when exact target/state authority permits; otherwise they remain non-substantive typed states.
target.full_distribution_law: An EmpiricalFact for a distribution contains the full governed target cell domain or an exact replayable domain reference plus every realized cell/support state. A modal cell or scalar association summary is not a complete distribution.

RAW.required_authority: raw count semantics and source respondent identity/risk-set authority

GOVERNED_WEIGHTED.respondent_measure: exact governed weight for each denominator member
GOVERNED_WEIGHTED.missing_or_invalid_weight: TYPED_WEIGHTED_MEASURE_UNAVAILABLE unless a separate exact authority defines treatment

measure.rule: If both raw and weighted results are requested, they are separate EmpiricalQuerySpec/EmpiricalFact identities linked only by an optional nonsemantic comparison group; equal numerical percentages do not merge them.
measure.numeric_identity: Exact numeric encoding/canonicalization is owned by the Wave-01 canonical object/authority synthesis. P02 requires an immutable measure_numeric_contract_ref and forbids binary/decimal rounding policy from being implicit.

modes.SOURCE_INDEXED_MULTI_UNIVERSE: multiple exact universes retained and evaluated separately by default
modes.AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE: one composite result only when exact independent source-relation/linkage/pooling/nonduplication/estimand/weight authority permits it

source_scope.source_disagreement: retained as distinct source-indexed empirical facts unless exact composition authority says otherwise

support_and_uncertainty.observed_zero: numerator zero with exact positive denominator is a supported observed-zero cell, not ZERO_SUPPORT and not impossibility
support_and_uncertainty.low_support: supported but weak/uncertain; never equivalent to nonexistence
support_and_uncertainty.zero_support: no empirical conditional basis; no nearest cohort fallback
support_and_uncertainty.uncertainty_rule: If no governed numeric uncertainty method is supplied, retain a typed unquantified uncertainty state rather than inventing one.

joint_reconstruction.fixed_unary: may be reconstructed from its exact complete fixed unary contingency and full identity closure
joint_reconstruction.fixed_pair: may be reconstructed from exact full same-respondent pair contingency plus exact risk-set/measure/provenance closure
joint_reconstruction.fixed_k_way: may be reconstructed from exact full k-way contingency spanning every target/condition dimension in that fixed query
joint_reconstruction.future_new_condition_or_target: requires respondent-event/coordinate incidence or exact information-equivalent carrier spanning the new dimension

hostile_examples.XOR: A and B may each have zero unary signal while Y is exactly determined by (A OR B) AND NOT(A AND B); exact same-respondent conjunction/joint incidence must remain queryable.
hostile_examples.PARITY: k-way parity may be invisible to all lower-order marginals; target/condition arity cannot be truncated to the strongest unary/pairwise signals.
hostile_examples.SIMPSON_REVERSAL: P(Y|X) and P(Y|X,Z=z) are distinct query identities. A pooled aggregate cannot replace stratified facts and a reversal diagnostic must reference exact source facts.
hostile_examples.SAME_MARGINALS_DIFFERENT_JOINT: identical unary marginals with different respondent pairings produce different joint EmpiricalFacts.
hostile_examples.ROUTED_ZERO_OVERLAP: zero common eligible respondents is ZERO_OVERLAP, not an omitted row, zero probability, or NOT_APPLICABLE unless exact routing authority says so.

forbidden_inferences: equal denominator counts -> same risk set
diagnostic score -> primary fact or structural truth
